intro.title: Scenario II-B: Dancing with Death
intro.part1: Despite its remote location, the prestigious performing arts school boasts a distinguished reputation in the world of dance and theater. Still, the long drive to Nussbaum Academy is a somber one. Your Model T rumbles along the winding roads, the scenery passing by in a blur of muted autumn colors. There’s a sense of tension that hangs in the air as you cross the Ipswich River and into Willowdale Forest, and every tree branch that scratches against your car’s windows sets your skin to crawling.
intro.part2:
For her part, Gigi seems largely oblivious to the ominous surroundings, and has spent the past hour meticulously applying makeup in a compact mirror while outlining her plan. The woman claiming to be Ana Giuliano has been using Nussbaum Academy as her base of operations for months, far from the prying eyes of Gigi’s trusted associates. While the school would usually be bustling with students at this time of year, she has arranged for a distraction: tickets to the Boston Ballet for the entire faculty, donated in the name of one of Nussbaum Academy's many benefactors. “If everything goes off without a hitch,” Gigi explains, puckering her lips as she paints on her lipstick, “we'll waltz in, get some dirt on Mother Darling, and waltz right back out. Easy street. Capisce?”

Under the cover of nightfall, you and Gigi finally arrive at the gates of the academy. Gigi orders your driver to hide the Model T nearby and wait before joining you at the compound's threshold. With most of the student body away at the theatre at this late hour, you're in a prime position to take advantage of the opportunity to scour the campus for information on Madame Giuliano.
intro.part3:
Over the course of the car ride, You and Finlay have crafted a plan for infiltrating the school—in spite of Finlay’s initial insistence on approaching with guns blazing. “Yeah, yeah, I know,” he says, his knuckles white against the Model T’s steering wheel, “You're right. We keep it cool, we have a better shot of pulling this off.” Though he has conceded to your better judgment, Finlay’s growing anxiety is as palpable a force as the rain on the windshield. It’s clear that his mission to find Naomi O’Bannion is the first thing on his mind, and the prospect of failing to do so is beginning to push him towards impulsive action. But as you approach the gates of Nussbaum Academy, it becomes painfully clear that all of your careful strategizing has been for naught. Even from a distance, you can see the plumes of smoke billowing from the scarlet manor’s windows, illuminating the building in a fiery blaze. “Ah, goddammit,” Finlay curses, his grip tightening on the wheel as he accelerates straight through the school’s gates and up the winding driveway. “I really hate this ‘no coincidences’ shit.”

As you slow to a halt, a young woman stumbles from the doorway of the old- world manor in complete hysterics. Her clothes are smudged with ash and dirt, and her disheveled brown hair clings damply to her face. Finlay dashes from the automobile, rushing to catch her as she collapses onto the gravel. “Lady, are you okay!?” He shouts, supporting the girl's weight in his arms. “What the heck is going on here?”

‘It's happening again. It’s on fire,” The girl mumbles, trembling. “It’s all going to burn down, just like before.” You attempt to reassure her, but her distress only escalates. “Can't you see? Everything around you will become dark, and someone will take your hand. You'll be pleased, not sad — you'll enjoy moments of incredible brightness.” She babbles frantically, and she edges away from you and Finlay, as though fearful of you both. “You see only the shadow of the smoke, not the smoke itself. Not the fire that it comes from, nor what fueled the fire—you don’t see death’s fingers on your shoulder!!” With a shriek of terror, the girl tears to her feet, and flees abruptly into the woods behind the academy. You're shaken by the encounter, but Finlay’s voice snaps you back to reality. ‘We can’t chase after her,” he insists, his tone firm. “If Giuliano’s in there, we've got to get her out now, or we'll never be able to put an end to this!” He's right. If Ana Giuliano is the key to quelling the escalating conflict between the mob and the O’Bannion gang, you can't afford to let what she knows go up in smoke.

rules.title: Exploring Nussbaum Academy & Keys
rules.body:
While investigating the sprawling manor of Nussbaum Academy, the investigators may become disoriented and confused by the estate’s winding halls. During the scenario, the active Jinx in play will instruct the investigators to “spin” the Performance Hall at the center of the estate.

If you are instructed to “spin” the Performance Hall, rotate the Performance Hall location in the center of Nussbaum Academy in the indicated direction as many times as necessary so that its title is oriented toward another location on the outer ring.

The Performance Hall is connected to the Academy locations immediately above its title and below its location connection symbols, and vice versa.

The setup of this scenario instructs the players to set aside 1 {cultist} token, 1 {tablet} token, and 1 {elderThing} token as keys. These keys are never placed in the chaos bag and do not act as traditional chaos tokens. Instead, they represent keys which investigators can recover and use throughout the scenario.

If a location with a key on it has no clues, an investigator can take control of its key as a {fast} ability.

If an enemy with a key on it leaves play, the investigator who caused that enemy to leave play must take control of its key. If the enemy leaves play through some other means, place its key on its location.

When an investigator takes control of a key, they place that key on their investigator card. If an investigator who controls one or more keys is eliminated, place each of those keys on their location. As an {action} ability, an investigator may give any number of their keys to another investigator at the same location.
